source: Directive tables of the Bareos 25.1.2 Director as carried by odir (crates/odir/src/commands/show_items.rs) plus Onesimus extensions (crates/odir/src/config_check.rs EXTENSIONS)
description: A Counter resource is a numbered variable, mainly used in Label Format of pools to number volumes.

examples.title: Volume numbers that wrap every year

directives.name: Name
directives.description: Name of the counter, used as a variable in Label Format (for example ${Weekly}).

examples.console: configure add counter name=Weekly description="Volume number of the weekly pool"

directives.name: Minimum
directives.description: Value the counter starts with and returns to after Maximum.

directives.name: Maximum
directives.description: Highest value; then the counter wraps to Minimum (and increments Wrap Counter).

directives.name: Wrap Counter
directives.description: Counter that is incremented whenever this one wraps, for nested numbering such as week within year.

directives.name: Catalog
directives.description: Catalog the value is stored in; without it the counter lives in memory only and restarts at each Director start.
